units.name: Rook
units.title: Alley brawler
units.blurb: Tapes his fists before breakfast. Hits hard enough to knock a turn out of you.

units.name: Vela
units.title: Neon witch
units.blurb: Draws her spells from the signs on Market Street, and the signs have opinions.

units.name: Pip
units.title: Slingshot kid
units.blurb: Never misses the one who is already hurting. Carries his ammunition in a lunchbox.

units.name: Lantern Nan
units.title: Paper-lantern healer
units.blurb: Lights a lantern and the worst-hurt of her team stands up straighter.

units.name: Exo Ed
units.title: Sweaty exosuit
units.blurb: Bought the suit secondhand. The pistons still work, mostly all at once.

units.name: Static
units.title: Antenna kid
units.blurb: Picks up every channel at once. Shares the noise, and you lose a turn to it.

units.name: Chum 3000
units.title: Mech cat
units.blurb: Four storeys of riveted cat. Eats scrap, and gets its strength back from whatever it bites.

units.name: Jetpack June
units.title: Rocket courier
units.blurb: Two engines on her back, a bandolier of bottle rockets, and no brakes.

units.name: Smog Sage
units.title: Chimney mystic
units.blurb: Breathes in the city's smoke and breathes out yours.

units.name: Biscuit
units.title: Very good dog
units.blurb: A cream poodle who bites twice before you have finished saying her name.

units.name: Drone Dee
units.title: Drone pilot
units.blurb: Flies a quadcopter with a pellet gun taped under it, and a spare.

units.name: Tagger
units.title: Spray-can raccoon
units.blurb: Tags the target, and the whole crew moves faster for the colour.
